newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Consortium presents Creditanstalt bid - source.
newsitem.headline: Consortium presents Creditanstalt bid - source.

text.p: A consortium of bidders for Austrian privatisation candidate Creditanstalt was presenting details of its planned offer to Finance Minister Viktor Klima late on Monday, a source in the ministry said.
"They're presenting their plans," the source told Reuters.

Savings bank Die Erste Oesterreichische Spar-Casse Bank has proposed to set up a holding company with its partners -- led by insurer EA-Generali and Germany's Commerzbank -- were said to have run into difficulties.
Austrian news agency APA earlier on Monday quoted a spokesman for Die Erste as saying the group of bidders was still in "intensive talks to reach a positive solution that will result in an offer".

Commerzbank has allegedly threatened to pull out of the consortium amid growing concern over the strong position of Die Erste, which is less than a third the size of Creditanstalt, in the proposed structure.

The government has been trying to sell its stake in Creditanstalt, Austria's number two bank with assets of almost 700 billion schillings, for more than six years. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
